summary:
# NOTES: "The B.O.W.C.: A Book For Boys" by Prof. James De Mille (Lee & Shepard, Boston, 1871; Gutenberg #56231). Dedicated "To Willie." Sequel-ish to "The Dodge Club." Single book.

## Cast
- **Rawdon brothers** (Bruce, elder; Arthur, younger): big, brawny, Roman features, dark curly hair; their rooms used for meeting. Bruce = Most Venerable Patriarch for May; has weak heart (palpitations, "doldrum") after cliff incident and river.
- **Bart Darner**: fair, round face, golden curling hair, merry; son of St. John merchant; founder of B.O.W.C.; runs away twice; wants sea; carries leather cup, pistol, sailor's knife; claims sailing knowledge but is ignorant.
- **Tom Crawford**: tall, slight. **Phil Kennedy**: small, slight; climbs signal tree, omelet failure.
- **Dr. Porter**: head master, Grand Pré School/Academy. **Mr. Simmons**: mathematics, mild, amiable, mineralogist. **Mr. Long**: English dept., rapid, energetic, stern, hard-seeming but warm; at cliff kisses Bruce; keeps fog-horn.
- **Solomon** ("Grand Panjandrum," "Perpetual Grand Panjandrum"), aged African-American cook, comic dialect, college cap/gown/red hood; spectacles.
- **Captain Benjamin Corbet**: skipper of schooner Antelope (smells of potatoes, rust, leaky); obsessed with infant "babby" (wife's child, "Bo-rax", "Ga-ga"); wife Mrs. Corbet. Mate named Wade (wife "Gipson" joke); sleeps constantly; drenched by Long.
- **Boys on trip**: Michael "Pat" Murphy (Irish, sky-blue coat, silk hat, Irish brogue; ate raw clams); Peter Fraser "Johnnie Blue" (pea-jacket, sou'wester); David Digg "Bogud" (geology, "David and Bogud are common"); George McLeod "Muckle" (red soldier's coat); Jacob Wiggins "Jiggins" (red bandana, grave, doubtful); William MacNamara "Billymack" (tail coat, top boots); George Henderson "Sammy Bam Ram"/"Sammy Ram Ram" (ragged; cook/steward, ate stores; stole pig).
- **Dennis O'Rafferty** (Denny), Irish; wife **Mary/Molly**; lost son Michael, born Aug 2 1830, died June 5 1845; grave at Five Islands farm; lived at Parrsboro previously; has hatchet gift from boys (initials carved).
- **Captain Pratt**: owner of Pratt's Cove, sawmill; wife **Mrs. Pratt**, herbal doctor; medicine list (~80 items); clam poem: "In the months without the R, / Clams a deadly pison are."
- **Micmacs**: mentioned re lobster baking.
- Gaspereaugians: name for Gaspereaux inhabitants.

## B.O.W.C. (Brethren of the Order of the White Cross)
- Founded by Bart. Officers: Most Venerable Patriarch; Venerable Scribe; Right Worshipful Commander; Grand Scholastic; Venerable Warden; each month rotates. Solomon made Perpetual Grand Panjandrum. Flag: black, skull-like bald grinning face, "B. O. W. C." Costumes: red shirts with white cross on back, belts, felt hats with feathers (lost in gale). Phrenological bust; "Blood!" "Thunder!" salute. Fog-horn/trumpet. Pistol (Bart's), hatchet (Bruce's).

## Chapter events (in order)
I. Meeting in Rawdons' rooms, May evening; Solomon's grand turkey order (10 turkeys, 20 chickens, ginger beer). Bart's flag, costumes from Brown's shirts altered by Maggie Lunt; feathers from Mrs. Porter. Bart history: Dr. Porter found him at inn 40 miles away; hidden in woods with Solomon's help.
II. Grand Pré, Basin of Minas, Blomidon, Longfellow quote. Procession to woods; camp by pond/dam; Dr. Porter offers schooner cruise. Teachers Simmons and Long plan Blomidon/Five Islands mineral trip on schooner Antelope.
III. Procession to wharf; ballast from Mr. Brown's stone fence; Corbet absent (found feeding baby); Mr. Long's fury; Antelope leaves; black flag raised; Brown shouts "Bring back my fence!"
IV. Blomidon ("Blow me down"); Five Islands; Captain Kidd jest; blue-bottles song; Captain Corbet sings "The Farmer's Boy"; squall; hats lost; seasickness; anchor at Five Islands (Pinnacle Island cathedral-like).
V. Explore island; Bruce hangs on tree root over cliff trying to get gull eggs; Simmons' rock falls; Bart & Arthur rescue Bruce; Long kisses Bruce. Return; fog; Arthur rows; Bruce rows last boat; rope slips from Arthur; Bruce faints, "Boys, I'm dying!"; boat lost.
VI. Schooner searches; Long blows fog-horn; anchors overnight; Corbet's theories; Long prays; dawn finds schooner back at Grand Pré.
VII. Boat drifts; Tom finds lobster; Bart shrimps; Arthur grips rope, boat pulled to shore; cook lobster in stones ("Micmac" method); camp on island.
VIII. Build spruce camp; signal staff (Phil climbs tree); lobster boredom; gull eggs idea.
IX. Explore; gull eggs; Bart shoots "wild goose" (actually tame goose of O'Rafferty); Dennis O'Rafferty; house; lost son's grave; breakfast; Dennis fetches Phil.
X. Phil's omelet failures; red shirt signal; schooner (Antelope) sees; Phil hoists flag; Long sends sandwiches; O'Rafferty ferries boat; reunion; hatchet gift to O'Rafferty; schooner leaves to Pratt's Cove.
XI. Pratt's Cove; cook/steward ate stores (8 turkeys, etc.); Captain Pratt's birch wood; "Bingo" song; Pratt invites them; shop low stock.
XII. Corbet's anchor cracked; Simmons/Long search party; Pat finds stones, throws them away; Johnnie catches duck with hook; Sammy steals pig; Pat roasts; Mrs. Pratt tea.
XIII. Antelope adrift (anchor broke off); Bart at helm; grounds on mud flat by headland.
XIV. Mud; shark ("shovel-mouth" dog fish) fight with Bruce, Bart, Arthur; sculpin in stomach; jaws trophy; stale bread; fleet returns; awaiting tide.
XV. Clams; Pat's illness; Mrs. Pratt's medicine cabinet; clams = poison in months without R.
XVI. White schooner passes without seeing; quilts as togas; Bart/Bruce/Arthur wade to schooner; Antelope drifts off; fisherman's boat rescues; Long arrives.
XVII. Long explains; "Jonahs"; provisions (pork, biscuit); mineralogy search.
XVIII. Antelope returns to Pratt's; poison report; Mrs. Pratt treated.
XIX. Pat confesses throwing minerals into mud; torchlight search, finds clam only.
XX. Mate roused with water; drifting; Corbet on babby; compass / sextant talk; "Flying Dutchman".
XXI. Blomidon avenged: Long goes ashore alone to walk to village; Corbet's spyglass fragment; Acts "fetched a compass" theory.
XXII. Calm; songs ("Uncle Ned", Bart's songs: "Should Capting Corbet", "Than pork and Indian meal"); wind; grounds on Cornwallis mud flat.
XXIII. Walk across mud (Bart, Bruce, Arthur, Phil, Tom; Phil loses boot; quicksand hollow; gully jumps; Tom nearly sinks); Bruce and Bart swim/ford Cornwallis River; Bruce's heart fails, Bart saves him; reach Academy; Solomon's welcome; banquet. END.
